description:
A CAD tool for extracting bits from Mask ROM photographs.


This release adds working autocompletion to the REPL on Windows. It no longer crashes when selecting both lines and bits for movement. Color histograms now include the HSL color space and hide inactive channels for easier visualization. Yara-X is now included for layout solving. MARC4 and MSP430 decoding are now supported. Adds support for Windows on ARM64.
